name: slack_send_message
description: Send a message to a Slack channel. Supports plain text, Markdown, and Block Kit blocks. Can reply to a thread via thread_ts.

channel.description: Channel ID or name (defaults to SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL)

thread_ts.description: Parent message timestamp to reply in a thread

blocks.description: Block Kit blocks for rich formatting

name: slack_send_dm
description: Send a direct message to a Slack user by their user ID.

name: slack_update_message
description: Edit an existing Slack message by its channel and timestamp.

name: slack_delete_message
description: Delete a Slack message by channel and timestamp.

name: slack_get_message
description: Fetch a specific Slack message by channel and timestamp.

name: slack_get_thread
description: Get all messages in a Slack thread by the parent message's channel and timestamp.

name: slack_reply_to_thread
description: Reply to an existing Slack thread.

name: slack_get_permalink
description: Get a permanent link URL to a specific Slack message.

name: slack_list_channels
description: List all Slack channels (public and private) in the workspace.

name_filter.description: Only return channels whose name contains this string

name: slack_get_channel
description: Get details for a specific Slack channel by ID or name.

name: slack_create_channel
description: Create a new public or private Slack channel.

name: slack_archive_channel
description: Archive a Slack channel.

name: slack_invite_to_channel
description: Invite one or more users to a Slack channel.

name: slack_join_channel
description: Make the bot join a Slack channel.

name: slack_leave_channel
description: Make the bot leave a Slack channel.

name: slack_get_channel_history
description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel with optional time range.

oldest.description: Unix timestamp — return messages after this time

latest.description: Unix timestamp — return messages before this time

name: slack_set_channel_topic
description: Set the topic for a Slack channel.

name: slack_set_channel_purpose
description: Set the purpose/description for a Slack channel.

name: slack_list_users
description: List all active (non-bot) users in the Slack workspace.

name: slack_get_user
description: Get profile details for a Slack user by their user ID.

name: slack_lookup_user_by_email
description: Find a Slack user by their email address.

name: slack_get_user_presence
description: Check if a Slack user is online or away.

name: slack_add_reaction
description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message.

emoji.description: Emoji name without colons e.g. thumbsup, white_check_mark

name: slack_remove_reaction
description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message.

name: slack_get_reactions
description: Get all emoji reactions on a Slack message.

name: slack_list_files
description: List files shared in a Slack channel or by a user.

name: slack_delete_file
description: Delete a file from Slack.

name: slack_search_messages
description: Search across all Slack messages in the workspace.

name: slack_search_files
description: Search for files in Slack by name or content.

name: slack_add_reminder
description: Add a reminder in Slack for yourself or a user.

time.description: Unix timestamp or English string like 'in 10 minutes' or '2025-06-01T10:00:00Z'

name: slack_list_reminders
description: List all active reminders for the authenticated user.

name: slack_get_workspace_info
description: Get basic info about the Slack workspace — name, domain, and icon.

name: slack_announce_deployment
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a structured deployment announcement to a Slack channel — app name, version, environment, status, changes, and URL formatted as a rich Block Kit card.

name: slack_broadcast
description: SUPER TOOL: Send the same message to multiple Slack channels at once.

channels.description: Array of channel IDs or names

name: slack_send_alert
description: SUPER TOOL: Send a structured alert card with severity level (critical, error, warning, info) and optional action button.

name: slack_dm_user_by_email
description: SUPER TOOL: Look up a user by email and send them a DM in one call — no need to find their user ID first.

name: slack_channel_summary
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a channel's info + recent message activity in one call — member count, topic, unique senders, thread count, and latest message.
